US.name: United States

trackAndTrace.system: CSV / API export for state reporting

regulator.name: State Attorneys General; California Privacy Protection Agency (CPPA)

rights: Know/access the personal information we hold
Opt out of sale or sharing and of targeted advertising (including via Global Privacy Control)
Limit use of sensitive personal information (we do not use it beyond what is needed to provide the service)
Appeal a refusal (where the state law provides this)
Not be discriminated against for exercising these rights
privacy.transfers: Personal data is hosted in the United States by default.

special.title: Your Privacy Choices (Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information)
special.body: We do not sell personal information for money. We may use analytics and advertising cookies only if you accept them; sharing for cross-context behavioural advertising is off by default. We honour the Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal and treat it as a valid request to opt out of sale/sharing for the browser that sent it. You can change your choice at any time using the controls on this page.

special.title: SMS / text messages (TCPA)
special.body: We send SMS only if you give separate, express written consent on a form. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Message and data rates may apply; reply STOP to cancel and HELP for help.

overview.laws: Cannabis remains a controlled substance under federal law; state regimes (and seed-to-sale rules) vary widely.
overview.advertising: State advertising rules differ (no minor targeting, no health claims). This site is B2B software marketing only.
overview.support: Budify records member and sales data, stock movements and audit trails, and can export reports in CSV so operators can supply data to their state track-and-trace and tax reporting.
overview.caveat: Budify does not file reports for you and is not a licensed seed-to-sale system. Track-and-trace integrations listed are roadmap items, not current features.

overview.laws: The Consumer Cannabis Act (KCanG) allows non-commercial cultivation associations (Anbauvereinigungen); advertising and promotion of cannabis and of clubs is prohibited.

overview.support: Budify supports member registers, age and membership-status checks, allocation-limit tracking and documentation exports that associations can use for their own record-keeping duties.
overview.caveat: Associations remain solely responsible for their permit (Erlaubnis), prevention concept, reporting and record-keeping duties.
